scientific_integrity: Two direct graph constructions and exhaustive 16-bit simplex-membership tests, checked elementary collapses, exact signed integral chain cancellations, independent mod-two ranks, Euler checks and a standalone reproducible verifier. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Determines reduced integral homology for exactly two sixteen-vertex graphs; it does not determine their homotopy types, cup products, equivariant homology or invariants for other strongly regular graphs. An unindexed equivalent calculation is a residual originality risk.
title: Mixed-degree dominance homology distinguishes the Shrikhande and rook graphs
